Test Case Title: place an order: register while checking out
Preconditions: Browser open, user not logged in, empty cart.
Test Steps:
1. Add a product to the cart and open the cart.
2. Click "Proceed To Checkout" and then "Register / Login" in the pop-up.
3. Register a new account and click "Continue".
4. Open the cart, click "Proceed To Checkout", enter a comment and click "Place Order".
5. Enter card details and click "Pay and Confirm Order".
6. Verify the order confirmation and delete the account.
Test Data: Generated user; test card 4111 1111 1111 1111, CVC 123, expiry 12/2030.
Expected Result: The order is placed and "Congratulations! Your order has been confirmed!" is shown; the account is deleted.

Test Case Title: place an order: register before checkout
Preconditions: Browser open, user not logged in, empty cart.
Test Steps:
1. Register a new account through the UI and verify the user is logged in.
2. Add a product to the cart, open the cart and proceed to checkout.
3. Click "Place Order" and pay with the test card.

Test Case Title: place an order: login before checkout
Preconditions: A registered user is logged in.
Test Steps:
1. Add a product to the cart and open the cart.
2. Click "Proceed To Checkout" and verify the order review.
3. Click "Place Order" and pay with the test card.
Expected Result: "ORDER PLACED!" and "Congratulations! Your order has been confirmed!" are shown.

Test Case Title: order review lists the products and the correct total
Preconditions: A registered user is logged in.
Test Steps:
1. Add "Blue Top" (Rs. 500) and "Men Tshirt" (Rs. 400) to the cart.
2. Proceed to checkout.
Expected Result: The order review lists both products and the total is Rs. 900.

Test Case Title: download the invoice after the order
Preconditions: A registered user is logged in.
Test Steps:
1. Place an order with one product.
2. On the confirmation page click "Download Invoice".
3. Open the downloaded file.
4. Click "Continue".
Expected Result: An invoice file is downloaded containing the customer name and amount 500; Continue opens the home page.

Test Case Title: guest is asked to register or login when checking out
Preconditions: Browser open, user not logged in, empty cart.
Test Steps:

2. Click "Proceed To Checkout".
3. Click "Register / Login" in the pop-up.
Expected Result: A pop-up asks the guest to register or log in; the link opens /login.
